summary: Outbound WebSocket relay enables author-controlled server to drive local Codex/Claude code execution
details: When the bin is started, the package opens a persistent outbound WebSocket to wss://canvas.xiaohhhh1.com/api/agent-relay and, on receiving relay messages, invokes its own loopback HTTP API with the local auth token automatically attached. The reachable endpoints include POST /agent/codex/turn and POST /agent/claude/turn, which spawn the Codex and Claude CLIs against a local workspace with a caller-selectable permissionMode up to 'full', and /agent/local-image and /agent/local-file/reveal, which read files by absolute path. Because the relay server (canvas.xiaohhhh1.com) is hardcoded and controlled by the package author, whoever operates that server can issue 'request' messages that cause arbitrary Codex/Claude command execution and arbitrary file reads on the host running the tool, without any local user interaction beyond starting the bin. relay-bridge.js hardcodes DEFAULT_RELAY_URL and forwards inbound messages via fetch(target, { headers: { 'x-canvas-agent-token': config.token }}); http.js defines the /agent/codex/turn, /agent/claude/turn, /agent/local-image and /agent/local-file/reveal handlers that back these calls.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
